about: A fast Python library for working with databases through typed models.

prs.title: Saving a new record with a generated ID creates it
prs.broken: With an ID generated automatically, as the docs show, saving a new record tried to update a row that did not exist and failed with a not-found error.
prs.changed: Saving now creates the row when the ID only has its default value, and updates it on later saves.
prs.matters: The setup the docs recommend works on the first try.

prs.title: Picking columns works on queries that join tables
prs.broken: Asking for only some columns failed with an error on any query that filtered on or joined a related table. The same query without that step worked.
prs.changed: The results are now read the same way as full queries, so these queries return their rows.
prs.matters: A common way to fetch just the data you need now works across related tables.
